entities.name: Query protein (512 aa)
observations: Sequence-derived length 512 aa; estimated molecular mass 57.15 kDa, theoretical pI 6.81, GRAVY −0.1875, instability index 35.626.
Strong full-length homology to reviewed UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate--2,6-diaminopimelate ligases: 40–41% identity, 97.7–99.0% query coverage, E-values about 10^-119 to 10^-122.

Likely EC 6.3.2.13 activity: ATP-dependent addition of meso-diaminopimelate to UDP-MurNAc-L-Ala-D-Glu in bacterial peptidoglycan biosynthesis; reference annotation indicates Mg2+ cofactor and cytoplasmic localization.
Pfam domains: Mur_ligase PF01225 (23–73), Mur_ligase_M PF08245 (116–323), Mur_ligase_C PF02875 (345–480).
Function is inferred from strong homology, not directly experimentally established for this query sequence.

entities.name: MurC-like DAP ligase Q894B7
observations: Reviewed Clostridium tetani reference protein annotated as UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate--2,6-diaminopimelate ligase, EC 6.3.2.13; reference reaction RHEA:23676.
Reference protein is reported cytoplasmic and Mg2+-dependent, participating in peptidoglycan biosynthesis.
